data.name: Midhuna
data.gender_notes: Midhuna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess of rivers and fertility, often associated with the goddess Ganga. In Hindu mythology, she is believed to protect and nourish life, bringing prosperity and abundance. The name Midhuna carries the meaning “River Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Midhuna usually hope their child will grow to embody river goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of nourishment, protection, and life-giving force.
data.etymology: Midhuna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “River Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Midhuna total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Midhuna is derived from the Tamil language and is associated with the Hindu goddess of rivers and fertility, who is believed to protection and nourishment of life, bringing prosperity and abundance. In Tamil Nadu and other regions of South India, Midhuna or Muthu (another form of the name) is a popular name for girls, symbolizing the blessings of abundance and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: Midhuna represents the divine feminine energy of life-giving rivers and nourishment. In Hinduism, she is revered for her role in the cycle of life and the prosperity she brings to individuals and communities. The name Midhuna symbolizes fertility, abundance, and protection, and is believed to bring blessings of health, wealth, and happiness to those who bear it. Beyond just a name, Midhuna represents the eternal flow of life force and the power of the divine to nourish and care for all living beings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Midhuna: Goddess of abundance and prosperity. Her name signifies the overflowing milk pot, symbolizing the endless supply of blessings in life.
